حززت (form I)
# حَزَزْتُ (ḥazaztu) /ħa.zaz.tu/: first-person singular past active of حَزَّ (ḥazza)
# حَزَزْتَ (ḥazazta) /ħa.zaz.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of حَزَّ (ḥazza)
# حَزَزْتِ (ḥazazti) /ħa.zaz.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of حَزَّ (ḥazza)
# حُزِزْتُ (ḥuziztu) /ħu.ziz.tu/: first-person singular past passive of حَزَّ (ḥazza)
# حُزِزْتَ (ḥuzizta) /ħu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
